stories.headline: Albanese launches Asia fuel diplomacy blitz amid Middle East crisis
stories.summary: PM Anthony Albanese visited Singapore to secure fuel supply agreements and is planning follow-up visits to Brunei and Malaysia next week. The diplomatic push comes as Australia scrambles to secure energy supplies during the Iran crisis, with Singapore agreeing to maintain fuel exports in exchange for continued Australian gas supplies.

stories.summary: Australia's domestic intelligence agency is seeking to remove sunset clauses on compulsory questioning powers introduced after 9/11. Critics warn this represents a shift toward permanent police state powers without adequate parliamentary oversight or public debate.

stories.headline: RBA expected to hike rates again amid persistent inflation pressures
stories.summary: Economists predict the Reserve Bank may raise the cash rate to 4.35% at its May meeting as inflation remains sticky and oil crisis adds to price pressures. The central bank has already delivered back-to-back rate hikes to 4.10% in February and March amid concerns about economic overheating.
